integrity: The two explicit witness tuples and checkable reference-edge profile tables are contained in RESULT.md and checker.py. This package provides a same-model mathematical review, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite spectra only for two explicitly defined quantifier-rank-two sentences on three independently ordered successor paths. No general small-model bound, classification of all optimizers, or proof of historical priority. The order-visible sentence includes full strict order predicates, unlike the successor-only language.
title: Sharp ten- and seventeen-point saturation thresholds for three ordered successor paths
